reeve-plugindev — plugin author workflow helper.

Usage:
  reeve-plugindev watch    --project <path> --backend <url> --instance <id> [--debounce-ms 250]
                               Rebuild on change; POST to <backend>/api/plugins/instances/{instance}/reload.
  reeve-plugindev test     --project <path>
                               Run `dotnet test` against the project's tests/ subfolder using the TestKit harness.
  reeve-plugindev validate --manifest <path> --dll <path> [--host-version <semver>]
                               Run the host's pre-flight validator (MetadataLoadContext only — no code execution)
                               and print the structured result without uploading anything.
  reeve-plugindev deploy validate <manifest> [--schema <path>]
                               Validate the manifest's `deployment` section OFFLINE against the published
                               deployment.schema.json (embedded; --schema overrides) + the strict backend parser.
                               Clear PASS/FAIL with pointer-path errors. Exit 0 = valid, 1 = invalid.
  reeve-plugindev deploy render <manifest> --provider kubernetes|compose|manual [--out <dir>]
                               [--gateway-url <url>] [--reveal-token] [--params <json>] [--plugin-type-id <id>]
                               Render the deploy artifacts (k8s objects / compose service / helm-values) from the
                               SAME desired-spec + renderer registry the backend manual provider uses. A revealed
                               token is a PLACEHOLDER (rwt_PLACEHOLDER) — never a real credential at author time.
                               Optional host roots come from Tls__TrustedCaCertificates (single-line PEM;
                               encode line breaks as literal \n).
  reeve-plugindev pack --project <path> [--manifest <path>] [--out <dir>] (--key <pem> [--signed-by <label>] | --unsigned) [--version <version>]
                               Publish every evaluated target framework into an OCI laye
